query:
SELECT slug, title, shortDesc, metaTitle, metaDesc, imageUrl,
  JSON_LENGTH(benefits) as benefit_count,
  JSON_LENGTH(faqs) as faq_count,
  LENGTH(longDesc) as longdesc_length
FROM services
WHERE slug IN ('municipal-services', 'catch-basin-cleaning', 'septic-repairs');

rows.title: Catch Basin Cleaning
rows.shortDesc: A blocked catch basin looks like a minor problem until your parking lot is underwater. Discount Drain cleans and restores catch basins for residential properties, commercial lots, and municipal road systems across London and Southwestern Ontario.
rows.metaTitle: Catch Basin Cleaning London Ontario | Residential and Commercial | Discount Drain
rows.metaDesc: Discount Drain cleans and repairs catch basins for residential, commercial, and municipal clients across London and Southwestern Ontario. Vac truck service, same-visit repairs, annual contracts. Call 519-451-8342.

rows.title: Municipal Services
rows.shortDesc: When a municipality's underground infrastructure starts to fail, every resident on the street feels it. Discount Drain has been the contractor that London and Southwestern Ontario municipalities call when the job has to be done right, on schedule, and with minimal disruption to the public.
rows.metaTitle: Municipal Sewer and Drainage Services London Ontario | Discount Drain
rows.metaDesc: Discount Drain provides municipal sewer lining, manhole restoration, water main repair, and drainage infrastructure services across London and Southwestern Ontario. Family-owned since 1970. Call 519-451-8342.

rows.title: Septic Service and Repairs
rows.shortDesc: A properly maintained septic system can last for decades. We provide preventative maintenance, inspections, and a full line of repairs and replacements for septic beds and sewers across London and Southwestern Ontario.
rows.metaTitle: Septic Service and Repairs London Ontario | Discount Drain
rows.metaDesc: Professional septic service, repairs, and replacements in London and Southwestern Ontario. Free camera inspection included. 24/7 emergency dispatch. Call 519-451-8342.
